checks.test: Anonymous users reach only the login; six private resources return 401
Wrong password, foreign Origin and oversized login body are rejected
Real login opens the app; session cookie is Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax
Administrative changes require a valid anti-CSRF token
Admin creates a user in the real UI; credentials can be cleared; hashes never appear in user listings
A separate user can enter with just username/password and cannot administer accounts
Disabling and resetting a user revoke active sessions and invalidate the old password
Changing a password and logging out revoke sessions on the server
